name: 96746 · Kapaa, HI
findings: ZIP 96746 (Kapaa) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 96746 (Kapaa) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 96746 (Kapaa) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).
